pending_interview.question: You are designing a recommendation system for a streaming video platform with 50 million active users. The system needs to serve personalized recommendations in under 100 milliseconds, update user preference signals in near-real-time as they watch, and support rapid experimentation (A/B tests across different recommendation models). Walk through your high-level architecture: what components would you include, how would you handle the latency and freshness requirements, and what tradeoffs would you make between model complexity and serving speed?
